nodes.label: Visual Facelift Directions
nodes.rationale: Each direction uses the same roster workflow so the choice can be made by feel while implementation may borrow details across options.

nodes.label: Clean Clinical Direction
nodes.rationale: Best if users like the current layout and mainly want it to feel more modern, trustworthy, and easier to scan; the tradeoff is that it remains conservative.

nodes.label: Command Center Direction
nodes.rationale: Best for daily planners who want a denser dashboard-like workspace; the tradeoff is a deeper navigation layout change.

nodes.label: Soft Modern Direction
nodes.rationale: Best if the app should feel more premium and pleasant without becoming flashy; the tradeoff is that softer surfaces need careful contrast checks.
